subject: Coffee w/ Encord at DSEI?
text:
Hi [NAME],

Wondering if you or someone from the [COMPANY] team will be in London for DSEI? Would be great to grab a quick coffee if you're available.

I lead the Defence team at Encord (~6 years old, 100+ employees & $50M+ funding) and we work several leading teams (Helsing, Maxar, Thales etc) - providing the platform to support a range of data annotation & curation tasks - helping them to iterate faster on the fine-tuning of their AI models.

Let me know if you'll be at the conference, and will be happy to get something on the books,

subject: [NAME] - what's new?
text:
Hey [NAME],

Been a while since you caught up with the team in Chicago earlier this year
- curious to know if there are any plans to scale up annotations in this
later half of the year?

From our side, been an exciting couple of months as we further our support
for Physical AI use cases - working with Boston Dynamics, Physical
Intelligence, and numerous AV customers - to support both VLA and 3D Point
Cloud annotations.

Have also seen a big surge of interest from ex-Labelbox customers following
their pivot towards serving frontier labs & de-prioritising platform
development.

Let me know if it makes sense to catch-up & will be happy to find a time
that works,

subject: Isabelle [SENDER] intro r.e. scaling Multimodal training data
text:
Hey [NAME] - great to meet you,

[SENDER] on my team reached out to Isabelle [SENDER] a few weeks ago, who suggested
that we get in touch with you

I lead a Multimodal team here at Encord, working with several frontier AI
teams including Thinking Machine Labs, Boston Dynamics & Wayve - helping
them to push the frontiers of their respective industries by building
scalable multimodal annotation, curation, & model evaluation pipelines.

Imagine you very likely have a handle on lots of this tooling built
in-house, but could be interesting to chat if there's an openness to
consolidate or explore more scalable tooling - happy to share some thoughts
on how we've helped similar enterprise teams to move to the next level of
scale,

Let me know if you'd be open to having a quick chat in the coming weeks,

subject: [NAME] - still looking for partners for QA & Validation?
text:
Hey [NAME],

Thinking back to our conversations earlier this year - and was curious to
know if you're still looking for additional partners for validating the
perception stack / generating training data?

Over the last six months we've seen lots of inbound demand from Physical AI
teams (inc. Woven-by-Toyota, Motional, Aptiv) looking to diversify 3D point
cloud annotations / verifications away from Scale AI, Kognik etc - so was
curious to hear if you're also open to exploring additional partners?

Know when we chatted previously we focused on the 2D curation stack - but
happy to find a time to set-up a demo of our 3D suite if this is of
interest?

subject: [NAME] - any big changes w/ annotations?
text:

Been a few months since we last caught up - so curious to understand how
you're thinking about [COMPANY]'s annotation strategy over the coming
months?

subject: Improve surgical annotation accuracy
text:
Hi [NAME],

I noticed [COMPANY] is expanding surgical data annotation efforts - critical function to connect surgical insights with robotic operations. We've been working with Moon Surgical, Kaliber Labs, and Telos Health at similar intersections, helping them improve annotation consistency across surgical video, robotic ops and medical imaging (DICOM/NIfTI).

With Encord, surgical teams consolidate these tasks in one platform. Our capabilities like temporal interpolation & tracking, nested attributes, and workflow orchestration have helped them reduce manual labelling time, capture granular surgical context, and flag deviations more reliably.

Would you be open to a quick chat to see if those challenges resonate with what you're seeing at [COMPANY]? We're flexible morning times CT.

subject: Strawberry picking accuracy - Encord reconnect
text:
Hi [NAME],

I understand your team recently joined forces with Tortuga to scale automated strawberry harvesting. Presumably the robotic stacks are more integrated and your robotic fleet have increased in size, I wanted to see if now is a good time to reconnect? 

Quick update on Encord since you last heard from us: We onboarded Bloomfield AI on similar fruit harvesting use case (& in adjacent berry types!) We've also expanded our 3D modality support with for AgTech customers, with the goals of unifying 2D+3D annotation, dataset curation and label QA capabilities in one platform. All with the goal of accelerating data iteration cycles for more accurate vision systems (and missing fewer strawberries.)

How are you thinking about pick accuracy at [COMPANY]? We're flexible morning times ET if you're open to a catch up.

subject: Picking accuracy for autonomous strawberry harvest
text:
Hi [NAME],

I understand your team recently joined forces with Oishii to scale automated strawberry harvesting. We're supporting Bloomfield AI on similar vision-based fruit measurement models (in adjacent berry types!) I'd love to connect and see if some of the challenges they faced might resonate with you (presumably now the systems are more integrated.)

In case Encord is new to you - AgTech teams (e.g. Bloomfield AI, Carbon Robotics & Four Growers) work with us to streamline data annotation efforts. We help automate 2D and 3D annotation pipelines (e.g. object/ keypoint detection & instance segmentation) as well as unify dataset curation and label QA capabilities in one platform. All with the goal of accelerating data iteration cycles for more accurate vision systems (and missing fewer strawberries.)

How are you thinking about training data quality/ model accuracy? We're flexible morning times MT if you're open to exchanging insights.
